accepted_contracts: Offline helper introduces no CLI, owner, lock acquisition, process, mount, network or eviction. Win32 signatures and GENERIC_READ/FILE_SHARE_READ/OPEN_EXISTING share mode are correctly declared in source.

Original WorkflowLock identity/types and continuous owner PID/birth/nonce are checked; current retained handle final path, disk type, single-link nonreparse identity and bytes are checked around reads.
Raw stream parts are <=448MiB, use bounded256KiB reads, exclusive creation, per-part offsets/size/SHA, exact EOF and full audited SHA; partial output is preserved on failure.

Raw-public predicate requires whole-image allocated and unallocated review, zero private or unknown bytes, full source byte count and SHA; this is a syntactic gate and cannot replace independently executed byte review.

Capture reuses published v2 owner/capture/contract helpers, checks fresh lease/current boot/original lock/proof/source pins, finite serial capture, actual RO mount, full inventory/public/notices gates and final controls/source drift.

Capacity counts regular data once, excludes duplicate hardlink content, adds controls and tar/compression reserve, and retains10GiB current disk reserve; self RSS is sampled rather than a kernel-enforced limit.
Public terminal contains state, counts, hashes and exception type; raw private inventory and matched bytes are not printed.
remaining_actual_gates: Existing-owner cold branch, exact phase/argv/deadline ledger and original native/WSL closure/finalizer integration.
Actual retained Windows deny-write/delete handle and cross-DrvFS write-veto fixture before crediting image writer exclusion.
Actual clean toolchain unmount/loop detach before handle; actual RO mount/all alias exclusion before logical inventory/capture.
Ubuntu VHDX raw read only after complete owned WSL/Linux closure and offline boundary.
Independent whole-file raw public review, or scoped logical full inventory/public/notices review as appropriate.
Actual remote upload, independent fresh full readback, exact reassembly, cold restore/build equivalence and recovery-backed eviction review.
scope: Source reading, authored pure tests, Windows default NOOP, independent in-memory fake API and stream checks only.

independent_positive_groups: Fragmented one-byte reads preserve exact 4/4 boundary and ordered original stream/SHA.
